title: The steps of a Western blot
caption: Proteins are separated by size on an SDS-PAGE gel, transferred to a membrane, and the membrane is blocked. A primary antibody binds the target and a labelled secondary antibody binds the primary; detection shows a band at the expected size, and a loading control such as actin checks that equal amounts were loaded.
alt: Six boxes in order: SDS-PAGE, transfer, block, primary antibody, labelled secondary antibody and detection.
description: SDS-PAGE: SDS coats proteins with negative charge, so they separate by size.
Transfer: proteins move from the gel to a membrane.
Block: stops antibodies sticking anywhere else.
Primary antibody: binds the target protein.
Labelled secondary antibody: binds the primary antibody.
Detect: a band at the expected size; a loading control checks equal loading.
